scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.description: scheme_v2.md explains the revised scheme; scheme_v2.jsonl records it for tools. These are complete versions, so later stages read the rules from one file.

groups.purpose: Every placement, with the changes kept separate
groups.description: assignments_final.jsonl contains the full placement record. assignments_final.count.txt records its reconciled count. assign_revisions_only.jsonl lists only the changes, so a reviewer can see what C1 altered, with the whole record kept in the first file.
fourth/fourth.jsonl records the fourth-order groups and their members. fourth.md explains why each group's members belong together and what the group means.

groups.purpose: What a direct reading of language revealed
groups.description: form_pass-C1.md records observations about turn structure, language and assumptions that the earlier category labels might hide.

tier_history.jsonl records changes across levels of the scheme. notes-C1.md explains choices and unresolved issues. handback-C1.md tells the next stage what changed, what was checked and what still needs judgment.
